what_happened.line: The Economic Development Committee set its fall town meet and greet for Thursday, September 26, starting at 5:30.
Members discussed how to streamline permitting for new businesses and a July 8 joint meeting with the planning board; no resolution was reached.
Members agreed to send flyers and a save-the-date to committee chairs, and to announce the event at the select board.
Sponsorship came up, with a first donation offered and no budget set; some members preferred only tracking donations.
Committee reorganization (chair, vice chair, clerk) was deferred to the July 25 meeting at 6 pm.

why_it_matters: The committee's work on how new businesses move through town permitting, and its link to the master plan, touches how easily a resident can open a business in town.
The meet and greet is to be funded by sponsor donations tracked informally rather than a set budget, so no town appropriation is involved in this item.
watch_next: July 8 joint meeting with the planning board, where Josie will take notes for the master plan steering committee.
July 25 at 6 pm: committee reorganization and a review of the charge and mission.
